item.title: Slop Debt
item.description: Tech debt has rules. You cut a corner to ship on time, you write a comment that says TODO fix this, and six months later someone pays it down. It is annoying but it is bounded. A senior engineer can look at a codebase with tech debt and draw a map of where the bodies are buried.

item.title: Statement by Prime Minister Carney on Canada-U.S. trade negotiations
item.description: We have recognised from the beginning that America has changed, and that we will not return to our old relationship. Our government understood, before many, that America is altering all its trade relationships. Putting tariffs on its closest allies and charging for access to its vast market.
